title: The Lord of the Rings
subtitle: The Journey Through Middle-earth
description: The complete released Middle-earth screen saga in chronological order.

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
movies.synopsis: In Middle-earth's Second Age, unlikely heroes confront a returning darkness and the forging of the Rings of Power.

movies.title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
movies.synopsis: Bilbo Baggins joins Gandalf and thirteen dwarves on a quest to reclaim the Lonely Mountain from Smaug.

movies.title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
movies.synopsis: Bilbo and the company continue toward Erebor, where they must face the dragon Smaug.

movies.title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
movies.synopsis: The forces of Middle-earth converge outside Erebor as Bilbo and his companions face the consequences of their quest.

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim
movies.synopsis: Helm Hammerhand, king of Rohan, leads his people through a desperate war that will give Helm's Deep its name.

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
movies.synopsis: Frodo Baggins sets out with the Fellowship to destroy the One Ring before Sauron can reclaim it.

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
movies.synopsis: The Fellowship is divided as the war for Middle-earth intensifies and the forces of Isengard close in on Rohan.

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
movies.synopsis: As armies gather for a final battle, Frodo and Sam make their last journey toward Mount Doom.
